rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $x509_header = "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----"
        $c2_get = "GET /images/" wide ascii
        $c2_post = "POST /news.php" wide ascii
    condition:
        $x509_header and ($c2_get or $c2_post)
}

arguments.summary: A compromised internal host (WS-FIN-042, IP: 10.0.5.42) was used to conduct lateral movement and command & control (C2) activity via a proxy IP (10.0.5.14). The initial alert was triggered by SSH brute-force attempts from the proxy IP against a bastion host (10.0.3.77). Investigation revealed that the real threat actor was operating from within the finance department, leveraging Cobalt Strike beaconing and DNS tunneling. Targeted accounts included root, ubuntu, and deploy_svc. All active sessions for these accounts have been revoked, and the source host has been isolated.

timeline.description: Initial C2 beaconing from WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) to external IP 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS.
IDS alert fired for Cobalt Strike beaconing (ET TROJAN signature).
Lateral movement observed via SMB to file server 10.0.5.50.
Brute-force SSH activity detected from proxy IP 10.0.5.14 to bastion host 10.0.3.77.
Correlation confirms WS-FIN-042 as origin; session tokens revoked for root, ubuntu, deploy_svc.
Host WS-FIN-042 isolated and flagged for forensic imaging and remediation.
